AssistedBillingInfo.description: What was actually charged — only delivered, verified results are billed.

allowClarification.description: If true, the endpoint may return a clarifying question instead of results when the query is too underspecified. Set false if your client cannot do a follow-up turn.

collection.description: Collection to search. Provide either this or `collections`, not both.

collections.description: Collections to search together (max 5). Results are merged into one relevance-ranked list and each result is labeled with its origin collection. Provide either this or 'collection', not both.

filters.description: Same filter forms as `/api/v1/search/query`; applied to every internal search.

includeFigures.description: Fetch and attach figure images (base64, in metadata.figures[].image_data) for the delivered results only. Adds latency; requires `includeMetadata`. `includeImages` is accepted as a deprecated alias.

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata in results

filterWarnings.description: Advisory warnings about the supplied filter — for example filtering on a field with no payload index, which is matched by scanning. The search still runs. Omitted when there are none.

journalMetricExpansions.description: How each journal-metric condition resolved to ISSNs; omitted when no metric filter was used

collection.description: Origin collection of this result. Populated only for requests made with the 'collections' (multi-collection) form.

metadata.description: Document metadata (title, authors, journal, etc.). Null when includeMetadata is false.

section.description: Comma-joined source section(s) of the article, from the normalized vocabulary (abstract, introduction, background, methods, results, discussion, conclusion, case, supplementary, other)

question.description: The clarifying question to ask the user

documentCount.description: Number of documents in the collection.

field.description: The filter field the warning concerns.

issnCount.description: ISSNs pushed down (a journal usually has both a print and an electronic ISSN).

QueryUnderstanding.description: How the endpoint read the query.

aspects.description: Facets asked about the entity (e.g. mechanism of action, dermal penetration, clinical outcomes)

entities.description: Entities the query is about (substances, genes, diseases, organisms, methods)

filters.description: Structured metadata constraints read off the query. Possible keys (snake_case, present only when the query named the constraint): 'journal' (str), 'publisher' (str), 'article_type' (str, JATS vocabulary), 'publication_date' ({'gte'?: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'lt'?: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}). Empty object when the query named none.

intent.description: What the query is asking for

RelevanceInfo.description: Why a result was judged relevant.

judgeScore.description: Relevance score assigned by the judge (0..1)

matchedTerms.description: Entity/synonym surface forms found in the chunk (for highlighting)

SearchRequest.description: Provide exactly one of `collection` (single) or `collections` (multi-collection search).

collection.description: Name of the collection to search. Mutually exclusive with `collections`.

collections.description: Collections to search together (max 5, unique). Each collection is searched with its own access entitlements and the results are merged into one relevance-ranked list; each result carries its origin `collection`. Mutually exclusive with `collection`.

filters.description:
Optional metadata filter. Two accepted forms.

Flat (top-level keys are ANDed): `{"journal": "Nature", "publication_date": {"gte": "2020-01-01"}}`.

Structured DSL (for OR / nesting): `{"and": [{"field": "journal", "eq": "Nature"}]}`. Operators: `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `not_in`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `between`. Combinators: `and`, `or`, `not`.

Exclusion uses `ne` / `not_in` / `not` — there is no separate syntax: `{"and": [{"field": "issn", "not_in": ["1234-5678"]}]}`.

Indexed on every collection (any other field is matched by scanning and returns a `filterWarnings` entry): `article_type`, `doc_id`, `doi`, `issn`, `journal`, `keywords`, `publication_date`, `publisher`, `section`.

Indexed on the editorial collections only (People Inc): `medical_board_approved`, `topic`, `url`.

`issn` accepts hyphenated or bare, upper- or lower-case X (`"1664-302X"`, `"1664302x"`). `doi` is matched case-insensitively and an optional `https://doi.org/` or `doi:` prefix is accepted.

`journal_metric.2yr_mean_citedness`, `journal_metric.h_index` and `journal_metric.i10_index` accept range operators only and are resolved server-side into the matching ISSNs; see `journalMetricExpansions` in the response.

includeFigures.description: Fetch and include figure images as base64 in metadata (adds latency). includeImages is accepted as a deprecated alias.

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata in results

query.description: Natural language or keyword search query.

filterWarnings.description: Advisory warnings about the supplied filter — for example filtering on a field with no payload index, which is matched by scanning. The search still runs. Omitted when there are none.

journalMetricExpansions.description: How each journal-metric condition resolved to ISSNs; omitted when no metric filter was used

queryId.description: Unique identifier for this query. Use it to re-fetch the same results for free within 7 days via GET /api/v1/search/results/{queryId}.

results.description: Ranked list of matching document chunks.

collection.description: Origin collection of this result — the name as requested, so a logical collection reports the logical name rather than the physical one it resolves to. Always populated.

metadata.description: Document metadata (title, authors, journal, etc.). Null when includeMetadata is false.

BearerAuth.description: API key authentication. Pass your key in the Authorization header as `Bearer sk_live_...`. An `X-API-Key: sk_live_...` header is also accepted as an alternative. Keys are created in the Redpine Connect dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

info.description: Hybrid retrieval API for searching biomedical and scientific document collections. Combines dense vector search, sparse keyword matching, and cross-encoder reranking to deliver high-precision results.
info.title: Redpine Connect Search API

post.description:
Agentic search: the query is interpreted, one or more internal searches are planned and run, every candidate is verified as actually addressing the query, and only verified results are returned.

**Billing differs from `/search/query`:** only delivered, verified results are charged. A clarification request or an honest no-results answer costs nothing. Internal search fan-out and LLM tokens are absorbed by Redpine.

Accepts the same `filters` as `/search/query`, applied to every internal search.

200.description: Verified results, a clarification request, or an explicit no-relevant-results outcome

X-Billing-Mode.description: How this query was billed. `live`: charged normally. `exempt`: the org is billing-exempt (no charge). `trial`: covered by trial credit. Never sent for `kill_switch` (billing disabled org-wide) — the billing headers are omitted entirely in that case.

X-Credits-Remaining.description: The org's remaining credit balance after this query. Omitted when the API key has its balance hidden.

X-Query-Cost.description: Cost charged for this query, in credits (6 decimal places).

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the daily limit resets.

403.description: API key does not have access to the requested collection

422.description: Validation error (e.g. query too long, invalid filter)

get.description: List all document collections accessible to the authenticated API key.

post.description: Search one or more collections using natural language or keyword queries. Results are ranked by relevance using hybrid retrieval (dense + sparse + reranking). Pass `collections` (up to 5) to search several collections in one call and receive a single merged, relevance-ranked list with per-result origin labels.
